title: Next: The Sky-Piercer
summary: Closing splash fuses the two active pressures the reader now knows: Sky-Piercer must move and the detained community coordinator must come home, but Launch-Shop can afford only one exposed route.
panelPlan: Full-page closing splash at dusk with Sky-Piercer secured on its mobile cradle, visibly flight-capable but unfinished. A single service road leaves the work site and disappears into the Mojave.

Use one distant, restrained Tethergrid presence—lights or aircraft silhouette—and a separate small detention/transport cue only as already-known pressure. Do not depict the rescue method or any future confrontation.
Visually converge what could have been two paths into one road. The page should feel like logistics becoming destiny, not like an action preview.
Set ONE ROUTE and ONE EXPOSURE as large isolated beats before the final NEXT title.
